source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Nicodim de la Tismana»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Νικόδημος της Τισμάνα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», and the years on it are the folder's own: «Οσιος Νικοδημος Της Τισμανα (1320 - 1406)». He is none of the corpus's five other men of the name. The Greek and the Romanian calendars keep him on different days — the folder's Romanian row is 26 December, and the Greek page itself sends the reader there for the life, «Για τον βίο του Οσίου Νικοδήμου της Τισμάνα βλέπε στις 26 Δεκεμβρίου» — so this row records the Greek day page read, as the schema's one row per church requires, and no change is made to the Romanian row. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn: it carries the dates, the note of his relics at Tismana, and the cross-reference, and nothing else.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (28 September 2026).

hymns.text: Celui Ce a Răsărit din Fecioara, Mai Marelui Păstorilor, ca o oaie de turmă ai urmat, Părinte al nostru Sfinte Nicodim. Cu postul, cu privegherea şi cu rugăciunile, te-ai făcut lucrător sfinţit de cele cereşti, tămăduind sufletele celor ce aleargă la tine cu credinţă. Pentru aceasta strigăm: Slavă Celui Ce te-a preaslăvit pe tine; Slavă Celui Ce ţi-a dat ţie putere; Slavă Celui Ce a arătat tuturor prin tine îndreptare.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Nicodim de la Tismana, glasul 1

english.text: You followed the Chief Shepherd, who rose from the Virgin, as a sheep of his flock, our father Saint Nicodemus. By fasting, by vigil and by prayers you became a hallowed worker of the things of heaven, healing the souls of those who run to you with faith. Therefore we cry: Glory to him who has glorified you; glory to him who gave you strength; glory to him who through you has shown amendment to all.
